reporter.title: CueMem: Cue-Guided Context Reconstruction for Long-Term Conversational Memory

rows.notes: LoCoMo 10 conversations, 1,540 questions, 4 categories, following LightMem (Sec 5.1). Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct used for memory extraction, answer generation and LLM-as-judge for all methods; all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embedding for all methods (Sec 5.1). Judge protocol 'following prior work (Wu et al., 2025; Fang et al., 2026)' = LongMemEval / LightMem; the prompt text is not given in the retrievable text, so judge_prompt left null. Baselines re-run under this shared configuration ('For all methods, we use ...').
